name: Hengong Precision Equipment Co., Ltd.
summary: Hengong Precision Equipment Co., Ltd. engages in the research and development, production and processing, and sales services of precision machined parts and continuous cast iron components in China and internationally. The company manufactures and sells hydraulic and pneumatic fluid machinery, plastic machinery, vacuum pumps, pumps, expansion engines, screw air compressors, and precision mechanical equipment and their accessories, as well as gearbox products, new energy vehicle sector, and other fields.
